3-5 years of Contracts and Grants experience
Uses skills as a seasoned, experienced research administrator to independently oversee extramural research
awards, and transactions related to contract and grant management and maintains contract and grant records in
compliance with institutional research sponsor policies. Works on funding of diverse scope where analysis of data
requires thorough understanding of complex regulations. Completes and approves transactions for signature by
manager or other authorized institutional official. Works on complex awards that may involve multiple
investigators and multiple sub awards. Guides less experienced staff. Works on complex awards such as
fellowship awards and cooperative agreements which require task budgets, option years, multiple investigators,
multiple sub awards and cost share tracking.
Demonstrated competence in the use of spreadsheet and database software in financial analysis, fiscal management and financial reports.
Thorough understanding of research administration guidelines of Federal and non-Federal sponsors supporting research and educational activities, preferably in a university environment.
Thorough knowledge of applicable compliance requirements related to use of human or animal subjects in research, financial conflict of interest, biosafety, etc.
Demonstrated knowledge of managing fellowship awards.
Maintains current knowledge of compliance regulations in all areas of research administration.
Ability to perform complex financial analysis and customized reporting.
Strong writing skills in a variety of styles to draft persuasive text for a variety of audiences while ensuring adherence to funding sponsor guidelines.
Demonstrated knowledge of generally accepted accounting, fiscal and reporting principles.
Ability to maintain independent judgment; strong organization and communication skills; and a customer service focus across broad and diverse subject areas.
Ability to track institutional cost sharing.
Ability to manage significant volume of transactions.
Demonstrated knowledge of effective grant funding processes, procedures and techniques.
